scope: P3-0 only; no forecasts learned, no LP, no workbook export

time.next_day_forecasts: internal continuation only; no early actual or binding purchase
time.anchor_h0: latest completed ten-minute actual PV interval (endpoint=issue time), used as boundary-point proxy
time.first_issue_missing_anchor: 2025-01-01 00:00: use same issue h1 as h0; no actual slot1 lookahead
time.night_rule: no learned full-year daylight mask; preserve nonnegative official forecasts

settlement.final_quantity: a (last effective normal purchase commitment before delivery)
settlement.price_reference: delivery-slot p_t from attachment1 (working convention; not adjustment-issue price)
settlement.unused_final_commitment: not refunded; a-used is not an additional cancellation
settlement.count_revisions: record all versions; main bill once per delivery slot vs g0
settlement.sensitivity_2: p*(last_quantity+0.5*sum(abs(adjacent_quantity_difference))); explicitly stipulated incremental rule, not uniquely implied by statement

output.plan_sheet_EQ: sum(p_t*g0_t); initial quote/reference, not another additive bill
output.adjust_sheet_B_EO: a_final_kwh (total adjusted ordinary commitment, NOT signed delta)
output.adjust_sheet_EQ: sum(final ordinary contract charges+5p*emergency); final actual daily bill (explicit export convention)
output.forbidden_aggregation: do not sum plan EQ and adjusted EQ
output.storage_sheet: actual C/D block sums and actual S0/S144, not nominal planned C/D
output.emergency_sheet: positive actual emergency events; combine only contiguous same-day positive slots
output.supplementary_required: decision/commitment version ledger + per-slot settlement ledger + physical time map
output.template_time_label_policy: preserve original B:EO labels; position j maps to H-END physical slot j; disclose OI-01
